message.reasoning_content:
Visual: feasibility page — the timeline bars: stage1 bar spans months 1-2, stage2 bar begins at 3... the third bar seems to extend to right edge past month 8 — minor. Also the "8" big number top right slightly clipped by decorative shape? Looks okay. Feasibility page: 阶段二 bar starts at month 3 and ends around month 5; 阶段三 bar from month 6 to right edge — bar extends slightly beyond the month-8 gridline to page edge, minor.

Notes page: card 2 "以上两项尚待确定" text near card bottom, fine. Layout fine, has empty space in "已完成" card.

Overall visual passes with no blockers. Minor improvement: feasibility 阶段三 bar extending past 第8月 gridline. Could record as improvement without revision—but improvements that aren't fixed remain issues. I could optionally revise notes page (content improvement already noted) — since it's an improvement, not blocker, I can choose to fix it once with revise_page to improve wording precision. That costs a rerun of one page including visual re-check.

Simplest: record visual for the three pages, then revise notes page for wording precision (improvement), then re-inspect notes page (layout+content+visual) and record, then finish. But content assessment re-check needed after modification: "修改后重查改动页并复核全稿内容". That involves re-recording content with global_summary for the whole deck.

Is the wording improvement worth it? The instruction: each issue must be resolved or recorded as remaining_issues. Improvements can be listed as remaining issues at finish. But I already flagged it; better to just fix it since it's cheap and improves accuracy of "未确定" claim. However risk of new problems. The page 6 has plenty of space; changing "以上两项尚待确定" to "材料未给出以上两项的具体方案" — safe.

Actually is it worth spending budget? Budget 600s, 2 CNY. We have time. I'd rather fix to raise fidelity: the requirement says "保留计划、未确定与已完成的区别" — labeling as 未确定 is fine, but claiming these are undetermined isn't in source. Fix improves accuracy.

Let me record visual first for these 3 pages, then revise notes.
